where_the_cost_went.description: each finding {finding, evidence, value} — which token class, which tool, which phase carried the bill

rework.description: work that had to be done twice, with the census evidence that shows it (errors, denials, repeated operator corrections)

said_vs_done.description: where the operator's messages and the tool histogram disagree — what was asked for versus what the session spent itself on

turning_points.description: the moments the session changed direction, each anchored to an operator message

caveats.description: what the census cannot show, stated so the writer does not fill the gap
